propositions: Rebar's high-precision committed trigger tier fires on 13.3% of diffs; the noisy project overlay tier adds 22.0%, totaling 35.3% combined fire-rate.
Three traced corpus bugs (fine-wisteria-solenodon, fervid-boring-python, eclectic-spotted-barb) trigger only through noisy-tier vocabulary and are load-bearing for this repo.

Project overlay entries use the project-extension mechanism to add concurrency-related tokens (.lock, retry, Popen, fork, setsid, stage_and_commit, push_tickets_branch, refs/reconciler/) and file globs without modifying committed routing.
Two-layer trigger design (committed high-precision tier + project noisy tier) must be documented in docs/llm-framework.md with measured fire-rate tradeoff and worked example.
Config-effect test validates that a diff containing index.lock fires the concurrency overlay under this repo's effective routing but not under committed-only routing.
